git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Decouple runner display from indicatif

The runner's TerminalStepDisplay and TerminalWorkflowDisplay directly
imported indicatif types to create ProgressBar instances with hardcoded
spinner config. This duplicated style knowledge from ui/spinner.rs and
forced the runner module to depend on indicatif internals.

Add factory methods to TerminalSurface — create_transient_spinner and
create_pinned_message_bar — that encapsulate bar construction. Update
both display implementations to delegate to the surface, removing their
indicatif imports entirely.
EOF
